description: Land Acquisition - Muththettuwegama, Imbulpe D/S Division, Rathnapura District
categorisation: This gazette notice is a formal declaration under the Land Acquisition Act for the compulsory acquisition of a specific parcel of land (1.3150 Ha, Lot 424) for the public purpose of building a university hostel. The content is exclusively focused on the legal process of acquiring land, including its description, location, and the procedures for interested parties to claim compensation. This fits the definition of a Land Gazette (Type 4), which covers "land acquisitions, transfers, or disposals" and "any gazette content primarily dealing with land, property, or real estate matters."
